_comment: Cadence rules for the marketing ops pipeline. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for timing — both the status engine (scripts/marketing/ops/status.mjs) and the /marketing skill read this file, so they never disagree. Mirrors docs/marketing/distribution/RECURRING.md; if RECURRING.md changes a cadence, mirror it here in the same commit.

blog.description: One anti-feed cluster blog every 7-10 days. The cluster only compounds if posts cross-link within weeks, so Google/LLMs read rapid clustering as topical authority.

weekly_atom.description: Founder-proof track: one demonstration 'atom' per week (a real messy input -> BuildOS structures it -> the relief), shot once and cut four ways. Distributed LinkedIn-PRIMARY (the buyer channel), then X, then an IG Reel on @djwayne3 (reach, collab-tag @build.os), then a clean product-proof cut on @build.os (repository). The engine nags on this exactly like the blog cadence so the weekly engine can't silently rot. Harness: docs/marketing/proof-content-harness/.

extractions.description: Every published cluster blog needs 5 social extractions drafted within 48h of publish. All five live in one publish kit.

tiktok.description: 2 TikTok scripts per blog (30-45s + 60-90s), recorded AND posted within 7 days of the blog going live. Each repeats the term-to-own >= 2x.

reddit_karma.description: 15-20 min/day of honest value, no BuildOS mention. Gate that unlocks T27 (first promotional post).

content_freshness_sweep.description: Verify dateModified bumped on recently edited blogs, spot-check changelog, flag canonical comparison pages older than 13 weeks (LLM freshness signal degrades past that).
